game: Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) platinum roadmap
basedOn: The official trophy descriptions, PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide & roadmap and its 100% completion checklist, and the Exophase list. Every stage below is either an official description or one of those published guides; nothing here is invented.

highlights.replay: no mission replay, no New Game+ — keep a save at every chapter end
highlights.freeRoam: free roam continues after the finale and nothing trophy-related locks

stages.title: Chapter 1 — the only point of no return
stages.blurb: Story trophies, and the game's one missable: Lucia's meditation lesson.
stages.beforeLeave: The balcony meditation at Jason's house, before Paradise Lost closes Chapter 1.

stages.title: Chapters 2-3 — questlines open
stages.blurb: Breakfast Run unlocks partner switching; Andy, Billy, Cal and Bret open their lines.
stages.beforeLeave: Purple optional-mission icons each chapter: none required, all feed the counters.

stages.title: Chapters 4-5 — the story sweep
stages.blurb: The mission trophies and the second gold fall here; the late questlines close out.
stages.beforeLeave: Nothing locks at the finale: every questline stays open in free roam.

stages.title: Free roam — the easy sweep
stages.blurb: One-offs: quiet robberies, partner stunts, leisure, shopping, vehicle discoveries.

stages.title: 100% and the big counters
stages.blurb: A Long Road runs on it: 250 stunts, 42 range golds, 14 drone spots, 50 challenges.
stages.beforeLeave: 200 scanned vehicles and 100 studied animals — scan from hour one or backfill later.

stages.title: Cleanup and the platinum
stages.blurb: The stragglers — usually Strangers & Freaks — then the platinum fires on its own.
